The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. A farm faces 50 stamped dockets, each costing $49 to have checked for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. The voyage is checked, not assumed. The glacier is on the docket. vault stays on the record.
